nodes.name: BUGS.md
nodes.summary: Living bug tracker listing currently open bugs by priority alongside a long history of fixed UI/UX bugs across the timeline, photos, transportation, and entity-linking features, plus a standard bug-report template.

nodes.name: CODE_REVIEW_LOW_PRIORITY.md
nodes.summary: Short list of low-priority code review findings — hardcoded Fahrenheit units, a stray console.log, an incomplete type export, empty catch blocks, a possible XSS risk in phrase-translation display, missing rel="noopener noreferrer" on links, and a Prisma 7.x type-compatibility note.

nodes.name: CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Structured audit of the codebase covering security vulnerabilities, TypeScript type safety, error handling, database/Prisma usage, React patterns, API design consistency, performance, testing coverage, code duplication, and DevOps configuration, each ranked by severity with prioritized action items.

nodes.name: FEATURE_BACKLOG.md
nodes.summary: Large backlog of prioritized and categorized future features spanning trip management, photo/media, location/maps, social/sharing, analytics, AI/ML, mobile/PWA, integrations, gamification, and export/print, with an implementation-effort quick reference.

nodes.name: IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md
nodes.summary: Snapshot of overall project completion status, listing fully implemented feature areas (auth, trips, photos, transportation, checklists, collaboration, etc.), known issues, remaining work by phase, technology stack status, and a database schema summary.

nodes.name: UI_UX_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Improvement plan targeting form-validation friction, visual design consistency, loading/feedback states, mobile experience, and empty states/onboarding, with a prioritized implementation matrix and a component-audit appendix.
